request.style: English, anthemic rock, gritty male vocal, driving electric guitars, bass, big drums, gang vocals in the chorus, determined and energetic, 132 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My legs are burning, my lungs are on fire
The road is long and the hill is higher
But I can hear them cheering from the stands
The ones who ran before me with their open hands

[Chorus]
Since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses
Let us throw off every weight
And let us run with endurance the race set before us
Fixing our eyes on Jesus

[Verse]
Abraham and Moses, Rahab at the wall
They didn't see the finish but they gave it all
Now the baton's in my hand and the time is now
I'm going to run this race, I'm going to show you how

[Chorus]
Since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses
Let us throw off every weight
And let us run with endurance the race set before us
Fixing our eyes on Jesus

[Bridge]
The pioneer and perfecter of faith
Who for the joy set before him endured the cross
Scorning its shame
And has taken his seat at the right hand of the throne of God

[Outro]
Fixing our eyes on Jesus
Fixing our eyes on Jesus
